audit.whatIsWrong: Six of seven level-chart rows said Pantheon while the page's own whys say the opposite: whys[1] 'genuinely even', whys[2] 'stays a coinflip', whys[3] 'even', whys[4] 'this is your spike', whys[5] 'you win', whys[6] 'unloseable'. diff was HARD at 7.5/10 next to a 52.16% Jax win rate and a report line calling it 'Tricky'.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Pantheon / Skill / Skill / Skill / Jax / Jax / Jax and matches the prose exactly. Pantheon owns level 1 only; from 6 on, Grand Starfall is a 180s global roam tool with no dueling power while Grandmaster's Might is a 110s duel steroid.
audit.corrected: Rows 1-6 flipped as matched full/content pairs with ratings realigned; diff EVEN at 5.5/10 and the difficulty and final-rating lines brought in line.

audit.whatIsWrong: Phase whys carried no cooldowns and the Level 6 row was described generically.
audit.why: The numbers are decisive here: Shield Vault is 13/12/11/10/9s, Aegis Assault 22/21/20/19/18s, Comet Spear 11s at rank 1, Grand Starfall 180s at rank 1 versus Grandmaster's Might at 110s. Aegis Assault's 22-second cooldown is the single most punishable thing in his kit and the page never said so.
audit.corrected: Phase whys rebuilt around Shield Vault's 13s and Aegis Assault's 22s, and Level 6 stated as the ultimate-cooldown mismatch.

audit.whatIsWrong: Jax's ultimate written as 'Grandmaster at Arms' in whys[4], spikes[2].text, mid and wants.you[1]. Aegis Assault is described as a shield that 'blocks your autos' with no mention that it is a channel, or that it only blocks damage from the front. wants.you[0] was garbled: 'Bait his point-click W stun and dodge nothing with it (E can't)'.
audit.why: Aegis Assault is flagged channel and untargetable-class in the kit: any CC cancels it, so a Counter Strike recast landing mid-channel ends it outright — that is the strongest interaction in the matchup and the page omitted it. The frontal-only block also means walking through him with Leap Strike beats it. The mirror (pantheon__jax) already established that Counter Strike dodges attacks, not abilities, so Shield Vault and Comet Spear land through it — restated here from Jax's side.
audit.corrected: Grandmaster's Might everywhere; the channel-interrupt and frontal-only facts added; wants.you[0] rewritten to a usable instruction.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Shield Vault as the matchup-defining cooldown with no number, and never mentions Aegis Assault.
audit.why: Aegis Assault at 22s is more than twice Shield Vault's late cooldown and is his only answer to a sustained Jax duel.
audit.corrected: Stated in the Levels 4-5 phase why.

edits.before: Counter Strike flips every AA exchange he starts. Only take the trade when Pantheon's Shield Vault is down.
edits.after: Shield Vault is point-click and lands through your dodge. Commit only in its 13s window, not into it.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Pantheon must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Let him spend the stun first, then Counter Strike the autos that follow and recast — his opener beats your opener, not your answer.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Shield Vault's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Aegis Assault is a 22s channel and blocks only from the front — your stun cancels it outright, so save E for the moment he sets the shield.

edits.before: Grandmaster’s Might stats win every extended duel from here on. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Pantheon's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Grandmaster's Might (110s) is a duel steroid; Grand Starfall (180s) is a global roam tool that does nothing in your 1v1. The lane turns here.

edits.before: Overall difficulty: 7.5/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Shield Vault and how disciplined your pattern is.
edits.after: Overall difficulty: 5.5/10. The lane is decided by surviving level 1 and cancelling Aegis Assault with your stun.

edits.before: Tricky matchup — difficulty 7.5/10, Pantheon carry threat 7/10.
edits.after: Even matchup — difficulty 5.5/10, Pantheon carry threat 7/10.

edits.before: Grandmaster at Arms' Armor/MR active plus the third-hit on-hit wins every extended duel, and his global R does nothing in a 1v1 — this is your spike.
edits.after: Grandmaster's Might's Armor/MR active plus the third-hit on-hit wins every extended duel, and his 180s global R does nothing in a 1v1 — this is your spike.

edits.before: Grandmaster at Arms flips it: the burst Armor/MR active plus the third-hit on-hit wins every extended duel, and his R is a global roam tool that does nothing in your 1v1.
edits.after: Grandmaster's Might flips it: the burst Armor/MR active plus the third-hit on-hit wins every extended duel, and his R is a 180s global roam tool that does nothing in your 1v1.

edits.before: Bait his point-click W stun and dodge nothing with it (E can't), then Leap Strike in and Counter-Strike the autos he throws after the stun
edits.after: Make him spend Shield Vault first — it is point-click and your dodge cannot stop it — then Leap Strike in and Counter Strike the autos that follow

edits.before: Reach level 3, and especially 6, where Grandmaster at Arms' Armor/MR active out-durables his entire early-game burst
edits.after: Reach level 3, and especially 6, where Grandmaster's Might's Armor/MR active out-durables his entire early-game burst

edits.before: Levels 4-5 stay a knife-fight: trade only when his W stun and Comet Spear are on cooldown, because that point-click stun bypasses your dodge entirely and his Aegis Assault can shield-block your opener. Hold Counter Strike for AFTER he engages — let him spend the stun, E the autos that follow, and recast for your own stun. Level 6 is where this lane stops being even: Grandmaster at Arms gives you the third-hit on-hit plus a huge burst of Armor and MR on cast, and since his R is a global roam tool with zero dueling power, you simply out-stat him in every extended all-in from here.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 stay a knife-fight: trade only when Shield Vault (13s) and Comet Spear are down, because that point-click stun bypasses your dodge entirely. Aegis Assault blocks only from the front and is a 22s channel — any CC cancels it, so your Counter Strike recast ends it outright, and Leap Strike past him beats the block. Hold E for AFTER he engages: let him spend the stun, eat the autos, recast. Level 6 ends the even phase — Grandmaster's Might gives third-hit on-hit plus burst Armor and MR, and his R is a roam tool with zero dueling power.

notes: Six of seven chart rows said Pantheon while the whys[] text said even-then-Jax, so the chart and the body of the page disagreed on almost the whole lane. Also fixed 'Grandmaster at Arms' in four fields, a garbled wants.you[0], and a real omission: Aegis Assault is a 22s channel that any CC cancels — a Counter Strike recast landing mid-channel ends it, and the shield only blocks damage from the front. That is the strongest interaction in the matchup and it was nowhere on the page.
